_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit that copy -- config.json is gitignored, this example isn't. Every field here is optional: case_solve.py has a built-in default for all of them, and every one can also be set with a command-line flag (which wins over this file). Run `python case_solve.py -h` to see them all.

azure_devops._comment: Same PAT as case-brief/case-guide -- see case-brief/README.md for how to create one.

claude._comment: model: null uses claude's own default. agent: the project-scoped .claude/agents/<name>.md to run as -- null/empty falls back to claude's plain default. timeout: max seconds to wait for implementation plan/steps. extra_args: raw flags passed to claude CLI.

customer_repo_map._comment: Optional. For customers that always use the same repo, add an entry here to auto-suggest it. Fuzzy-match on customer_contains.
